description: Masked critical evidence leads to false negative. Similar to CB_00000227 pattern from dev set.
why_conservative: Missing critical delivery evidence (marked not_available) reduces the score below CONTEST threshold. System prioritizes avoiding false positives when evidence is incomplete.

comparison_to_dev.same_pattern: Masked delivery_confirmed + risk factors → conservative decision
comparison_to_dev.difference: Dev case scored 30, heldout case scored 40 - both below DO_NOT_CONTEST threshold

note: This demonstrates the system's conservative approach when critical evidence is unavailable. In production, these cases would benefit from manual evidence gathering before making final decision.
